title: 文化传承与交流
desc: 文化遗产保护、文化自信与跨文化交流的高分表达，适用于图画作文论证与结尾升华段。

entries.example: The ancient town stands as a living testimony to our rich cultural heritage.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古镇是我们丰富文化遗产的鲜活见证。
entries.note: 常与 preserve, protect, hand down 搭配；首段点题与结尾升华均适用。

entries.example: Paper-cutting was added to the UNESCO list of intangible cultural heritage in 2009.
entries.exampleZh: 剪纸于2009年被列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录。
entries.note: 常与 be listed as, be inscribed on 连用；不可数，首段点题好用。

entries.zh: 历史悠久的，久负盛名的
entries.example: This time-honored craft has been handed down through more than twenty generations.
entries.exampleZh: 这门历史悠久的技艺已传承二十多代。
entries.note: 多作定语修饰 craft, brand, tradition；很少作表语。

entries.example: The centuries-old tradition of dragon boat racing still draws huge crowds today.
entries.exampleZh: 延续数百年的赛龙舟传统如今仍吸引着大批人群。
entries.note: 作定语须带连字符；若指多个世纪用 centuries-old，勿写 century-old。

entries.example: Ancestral wisdom is embedded in every line of these ancient farming manuals.
entries.exampleZh: 祖先的智慧蕴含在这些古代农书的字里行间。
entries.note: 抽象不可数，前可加 the；与 draw on, inherit 连用表汲取传承。

entries.example: We have inherited a precious legacy from those who came before us.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从先辈那里继承了一笔宝贵的遗产。
entries.note: 常与 leave, inherit, carry on 搭配；可替换 heritage 避免重复。

entries.en: be on the verge of extinction
entries.example: Dozens of regional dialects are now on the verge of extinction.
entries.exampleZh: 数十种地方方言如今濒临消亡。
entries.note: 后接名词或动名词；verge 前定冠词 the 不可省略。

entries.example: Preserving traditional villages calls for both funding and public awareness.
entries.exampleZh: 保护传统村落既需要资金，也需要公众意识。
entries.note: 名词形式 preservation；常接 cultural relics, heritage 等词，用于对策段。

entries.example: Stricter laws are needed to safeguard our cultural relics from destruction.
entries.exampleZh: 需要更严格的法律来保护文物免遭破坏。
entries.note: 比 protect 更正式，多用于法律政策语境；常用 safeguard sth from sth。

entries.example: Young people should inherit not only the skills but the spirit behind them.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻人不仅应继承技艺，更应继承技艺背后的精神。
entries.note: 搭配 inherit sth from sb，不可写成 inherit to sb；用于传承话题。

entries.en: pass down from generation to generation
entries.example: The folk song has been passed down from generation to generation by word of mouth.
entries.exampleZh: 这首民歌通过口耳相传世代流传。
entries.note: 常用被动 be passed down；也可换成 hand down 保持变化。

entries.example: It is our duty to carry forward the fine traditions of our nation.
entries.exampleZh: 传承民族的优良传统是我们的责任。
entries.note: 及物，后接 tradition, spirit, culture；段末呼吁句高频。

entries.example: Short videos have helped revitalize traditional opera among young audiences.
entries.exampleZh: 短视频帮助传统戏曲在年轻观众中重获生机。
entries.note: 名词为 revitalization；主语多为 policy, technology，突出手段与效果。

entries.example: Creative marketing has rejuvenated several long-established Chinese brands.
entries.exampleZh: 创意营销让多个老字号中国品牌焕发活力。
entries.note: 强调恢复青春活力，可替换 revitalize；注意重音在第二音节。

entries.example: A nation with cultural confidence embraces foreign influences without losing itself.
entries.exampleZh: 拥有文化自信的民族能接纳外来影响而不迷失自我。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 build, strengthen, boost 搭配；结尾升华段好用。

entries.example: Language lies at the very core of a nation's cultural identity.
entries.exampleZh: 语言是一个民族文化认同的核心所在。
entries.note: 可加 a 或物主代词；常与 preserve, strengthen, lose 连用。

entries.example: We take pride in the remarkable achievements of our ancient civilization.
entries.exampleZh: 我们为古代文明的卓越成就感到自豪。
entries.note: 主语须为人；等于 be proud of 但更正式，勿写成 take pride of。

entries.example: The successful mission stirred a strong sense of national pride nationwide.
entries.exampleZh: 这次任务的成功在全国激起了强烈的民族自豪感。
entries.note: 常用 a sense of national pride；与 stir, awaken 搭配，用于结尾升华。

entries.example: Cultural exchange broadens the horizons of both sides and dissolves prejudice.
entries.exampleZh: 文化交流拓宽双方视野，并消解偏见。
entries.note: 多作不可数；常与 promote, facilitate 搭配，可作交流类中心句。

entries.example: Cross-cultural communication calls for tolerance, empathy and a willingness to listen.
entries.exampleZh: 跨文化交际需要宽容、共情和倾听的意愿。
entries.note: 不可数；形容词用 cross-cultural，勿写成 cross-culture。

entries.example: Cultural diversity should be celebrated as a source of vitality rather than a threat.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应把文化多样性视为活力之源而非威胁来珍视。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 respect, protect, appreciate 搭配；对比句好用。

entries.example: Cultural integration does not mean abandoning the roots of one's own tradition.
entries.exampleZh: 文化融合并不意味着抛弃自身传统的根基。
entries.note: 也可用 cultural blending；后接 of 或 with，注意与融合对象搭配。

entries.example: Mutual understanding is the cornerstone of lasting friendship between nations.
entries.exampleZh: 相互理解是国家间持久友谊的基石。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 promote, foster, enhance 搭配，比 understand each other 正式。

entries.example: Cultural festivals help bridge the gap between the East and the West.
entries.exampleZh: 文化节能帮助弥合东西方之间的隔阂。
entries.note: 常用结构 bridge the gap between A and B，也可用于代际之间。

entries.example: Many students experience culture shock during their first months abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生在出国头几个月会经历文化冲击。
entries.note: 常用 experience, get over culture shock；前一般不加冠词，作举例素材。

entries.example: More and more Chinese cultural products are going global with remarkable success.
entries.exampleZh: 越来越多的中国文化产品正成功走向世界。
entries.note: 不及物，后不接宾语；多用进行时或完成时。

entries.example: Cultural soft power matters as much as economic strength in today's world.
entries.exampleZh: 当今世界，文化软实力与经济实力同等重要。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 enhance, build, project 搭配，常与 hard power 对照。

entries.example: The documentary won international recognition for its poetic portrayal of rural life.
entries.exampleZh: 这部纪录片因诗意地描绘乡村生活而赢得国际认可。
entries.note: 用 for 引出原因；也可换成 gain 或 earn recognition。

entries.example: Peking Opera combines singing, dancing, mime and acrobatics in one art form.
entries.exampleZh: 京剧将唱、做、念、打融于一种艺术形式之中。
entries.note: 传统译名用 Peking Opera，作专有名词首字母大写，前加 the。

entries.example: Practising calligraphy calms the mind and sharpens one's sense of beauty.
entries.exampleZh: 练习书法能静心并提升审美感受力。
entries.note: 不可数；英式拼写 practising；写作中可写 Chinese calligraphy 更明确。

entries.example: Chinese martial arts embody both physical strength and moral discipline.
entries.exampleZh: 中华武术既体现体魄之力，也体现道德修养。
entries.note: 惯用复数；作定语可说 martial arts film 或 martial arts culture。

entries.example: Dragon boat racing is held every year to commemorate the poet Qu Yuan.
entries.exampleZh: 每年举行赛龙舟以纪念诗人屈原。
entries.note: 不可数，谓语用单数；常作传统节日文化的举例素材。

entries.example: Paper-cutting turns a plain sheet of red paper into an exquisite work of art.
entries.exampleZh: 剪纸把一张普通的红纸变成精美的艺术品。
entries.note: 不可数；连字符不可省；常作为非遗代表作举例。

entries.example: Suzhou embroidery is renowned for its delicacy and vivid coloring.
entries.exampleZh: 苏绣以其精致细腻和色彩鲜活而闻名。
entries.note: 不可数；be renowned for 是高分搭配，可替换 be famous for。

entries.example: Chinese tea culture reflects a lasting pursuit of harmony and serenity.
entries.exampleZh: 中国茶文化体现着对和谐与宁静的持久追求。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 inherit, promote 搭配，可与 coffee culture 对照。

entries.example: Good designers integrate tradition with modernity instead of copying the past.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的设计师将传统与现代融合，而非照搬过去。
entries.note: 结构为 integrate A with B；也可用 blend tradition and modernity 替换，用于融合类论证。

entries.example: Digital technology has injected new vitality into museums and ancient towns.
entries.exampleZh: 数字技术为博物馆和古镇注入了新的活力。
entries.note: 结构为 inject sth into sth，不可写成 inject sth to sth，用于对策句。

entries.example: Even classical art forms must keep up with the times to survive.
entries.exampleZh: 即便是古典艺术形式也必须与时俱进才能生存。
entries.note: 主语多为文化形式、观念或企业；比 follow the trend 更正式。

entries.example: A cultured person should be well-versed in both Chinese and Western classics.
entries.exampleZh: 一个有文化修养的人应精通中西经典。
entries.note: 介词固定用 in；程度强于 be familiar with，多用于修饰人。

entries.example: Reading classical poetry refines one's mind and elevates one's taste.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读古典诗词能陶冶心性、提升品位。
entries.note: 主语多为阅读或艺术等抽象活动；宾语常用 one's mind 或 taste。

entries.zh: 富有启发的，令人开悟的
entries.example: The documentary offers an enlightening account of ancient rituals and beliefs.
entries.exampleZh: 这部纪录片对古代仪式与信仰作了富有启发的讲述。
entries.note: 可作定语或表语；修饰 book, lecture, experience，常与 offer 连用。

entries.en: Cultural heritage is not a relic of the past but a living ___ that still shapes us.
entries.zh: 文化遗产不是过去的遗物，而是至今仍在塑造我们的鲜活___。
entries.example: Cultural heritage is not a relic of the past but a living force that still shapes us.
entries.exampleZh: 文化遗产不是过去的遗物，而是至今仍在塑造我们的鲜活力量。
entries.note: 用于首段或结尾升华；空缺处填 force, tradition, memory 等抽象名词。

entries.en: It is ___ that keeps our culture alive.
entries.zh: 正是___让我们的文化得以延续。
entries.example: It is the younger generation that keeps our culture alive.
entries.exampleZh: 正是年轻一代让我们的文化得以延续。
entries.note: 强调句型；空缺处填名词或动名词短语，被强调部分为复数时仍用 that。

entries.en: Only by ___ can we pass our cultural treasures on to the next generation.
entries.zh: 只有通过___，我们才能把文化瑰宝传给下一代。
entries.example: Only by respecting tradition can we pass our cultural treasures on to the next generation.
entries.exampleZh: 只有尊重传统，我们才能把文化瑰宝传给下一代。
entries.note: Only by 后接动名词，主句须部分倒装，用 can, will 等情态动词。

entries.en: What makes a culture enduring is not ___ but ___.
entries.zh: 让一种文化历久弥新的不是___，而是___。
entries.example: What makes a culture enduring is not its wealth but its willingness to open up.
entries.exampleZh: 让一种文化历久弥新的不是财富，而是它开放包容的意愿。
entries.note: 主语从句作主语，谓语用单数 is；两个空缺处词性必须一致。

entries.en: Exchanges between civilizations should be built on equality and mutual respect rather than ___.
entries.zh: 文明间的交流应建立在平等与相互尊重之上，而不是___。
entries.example: Exchanges between civilizations should be built on equality and mutual respect rather than arrogance.
entries.exampleZh: 文明间的交流应建立在平等与相互尊重之上，而不是傲慢。
entries.note: 常用于交流类结尾；rather than 前后词性或形式须一致。

entries.en: A people without the knowledge of their past history, origin and culture is like a tree without roots.
entries.zh: 一个不了解自身历史、渊源与文化的民族，就像一棵没有根的树。
entries.example: A people without the knowledge of their past history, origin and culture is like a tree without roots.
entries.exampleZh: 一个不了解自身历史、渊源与文化的民族，就像一棵没有根的树。
entries.note: 出处：马库斯·加维；适用于文化遗产、文化自信类开头或结尾。

entries.en: A nation's culture resides in the hearts and in the soul of its people.
entries.zh: 一个民族的文化存在于其人民的心灵与灵魂之中。
entries.example: A nation's culture resides in the hearts and in the soul of its people.
entries.exampleZh: 一个民族的文化存在于其人民的心灵与灵魂之中。
entries.note: 出处：甘地；适用于文化自信、文化交流类收尾句。

entries.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
entries.example: When in Rome, do as the Romans do, and respect local customs while travelling.
entries.exampleZh: 入乡随俗，旅行时要尊重当地风俗。
entries.note: 英语谚语；适用于跨文化适应类，举例或总结均可。

entries.en: Study the past if you would define the future.
entries.zh: 若想定义未来，就要研究过去。
entries.example: Study the past if you would define the future, as tradition lights our way forward.
entries.exampleZh: 若想定义未来，就要研究过去，因为传统照亮我们前行的路。
entries.note: 常归于孔子；适用于文化传承类结尾，与尊重传统相呼应。
